# composio_toolkit (Data Source)

Reads a Composio toolkit by slug. Requires a project API key (`x-api-key`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "composio_toolkit" "github" {
  slug = "github"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Toolkit slug, for example `github`.

### Read-Only

- `app_url` (String) Upstream application URL, when present.
- `auth_schemes` (Set of String) Supported authentication schemes.
- `description` (String) Toolkit description.
- `id` (String) Same as `slug`.
- `logo` (String) Logo URL.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `no_auth` (Boolean) True when the toolkit can be used without authentication.
- `tools_count` (Number) Number of tools in the toolkit.
- `triggers_count` (Number) Number of trigger types in the toolkit.
- `type` (String) `native` or `custom`.
- `version` (String) Toolkit version reported by Composio.
